skillFull: Casts a coffee spell at certain intervals to create Latte Art, creating Latte Foam Jellies along the edges and gathering nearby Jellies. Jellies gathered by the Latte Art grant bonus points. After casting a certain number of spells, a larger and more powerful Latte Art is created. Level Up for more points for Latte Foam Jellies.
story:
Coffee or milk... that is the question. Why not both? Latte Cookie's dough was formed with coffee most bitter and acrid, balanced with the creamiest and smoothest blend of milk. With her etched staff in hand, she gracefully draws beautifully patterned Latte Glyphs in the air while daydreaming. But watch out! By chance, one of these Glyphs could be a powerful sigil for a grand spell!

During her years as a student, she spearheaded research on the development of Coffee Magic with a rather eccentric afficionado of coffee. Thanks to her efforts, Latte Cookie was granted a professorship at the Parfaedia Magic Institute. You'd think that a professor would be more punctual, especially with their own lectures. But not Latte Cookie! She's more invested in savoring a warm latte before class.

Though far from achieving the Professor of the Year Reward, she knows a thing or two about inspiring her students. With her genuine compliments and encoraging smile, Latte Cookie is already the favorite professor of many.

sections.title: Cookie Info & Loading
lines: Oh gosh! I'm late for class! Wait... I'm on vacation!
No rush, no worries about being tardy... Now THIS is a vacation!
I have a vacation rule! Lattes are only served with ice, haha!
Keep your cool and be confident! Promise?*

Everyone finds their own pace in their own time!
Well-rested teachers make the best teachers, don't you think?

costumes.info: Latte Cookie is finally on vacation. No lectures to rush to, no schedules to keep...! Just the open beach and the quiet joy of taking it slow. As the warm orange glow of the sunset paints the fading sky gently, she wonders if every day could feel just like this one.
